headlines.title: Senate leaders reach a deal to avert a shutdown before the 2026 elections
headlines.description: Senate leaders have struck a bipartisan agreement to keep the government funded past the 2026 midterm elections and avoid a shutdown in October.

headlines.title: Ethics panel recommends censure for GOP Rep. Chuck Edwards for ‘inappropriate conduct’
headlines.description: The House Ethics Committee is recommending that Rep. Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., be censured by after finding that he engaged “inappropriate conduct towards two young female staffers.”

headlines.title: Trump’s AG pick scraps ‘anti-weaponization’ fund in deal with holdout senators
headlines.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee is set to hold a vote to advance Blanche’s nomination Tuesday.

headlines.title: Trump: Jeanine Pirro 'made a mistake' dropping Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Trump said U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro "made a mistake" by dropping the cases against individuals accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. has had 'many talks' with Iran
headlines.description: President Donald Trump told reporters the U.S. continues to hold talks with Iran to reach a new peace deal focused on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran's nuclear program.

headlines.title: Sen. Moreno Says Ex-Son-in-Law Max Miller Unfit for Congress
headlines.description: Ohio GOP Rep. Max Miller is denying troubling accusations of domestic abuse against his ex-wife Emily Moreno, as he runs for re-election to a third term in Congress. Moreno’s father, Sen. Bernie Moreno of Ohio, has called on Miller to step down. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Former Texas Rep. Kay Granger dies at 83
headlines.description: Republican former Rep. Kay Granger of Texas has died, lawmakers announced Sunday.

headlines.title: Govs. Kevin Stitt and Wes Moore call for bringing ‘dignity’ back to government
headlines.description: Stitt and Moore said social media contributes to negativity and polarization in politics and urged more in-person connections.

headlines.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno says former son-in-law Max Miller shouldn’t serve in Congress following abuse allegations
headlines.description: Rep. Max Miller, R-Ohio, denied allegations that he abused the senator’s daughter and chastised him for speaking out.

headlines.title: Rep. Marcy Kaptur hospitalized after hit-and-run car crash
headlines.description: A spokesperson said Kaptur, D-Ohio, is alert and being treated for non-life-threatening injuries.

headlines.title: Sen. John Kennedy says he’d exclude Jan. 6 rioters from an ‘anti-weaponization’ fund bill
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy, R-La., told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” he would’nt provide the Trump administration with a “blank check” for the proposed “anti-weaponization” fund.
